errors.text_span: Върху всеки стълб е поставена точна числовата стойност
errors.evidence: The description claims that every bar has a numerical value label on it. However, the bar representing men in Croatia (Хърватия) does not have a value label.

The description of the y-axis is incomplete. It mentions the scale (0-50) and intervals (10), but omits the full axis label, which is 'Общо работни часове на седмица, включително извънреден труд (средно)' (Total working hours per week, including overtime (average)).
